name: KasuMeta
description: Note: this plugin has no effect on Jellyfin's stock UI. It is made for other frontends to consume: the localized metadata is only served through its own /KasuMeta API, which a client app must call itself. Jellyfin's web client and official apps keep showing the library's own metadata. Stores localized metadata beside Jellyfin (its own SQLite file): titles, overviews, taglines, genres, tags and artwork per locale from TMDB, TVDB and AniList, chosen per field, with an original-language fallback, search by localized name, and admin overrides and image uploads. Requires Jellyfin 12.x and a TMDB or TVDB API key.
overview: Localized titles, overviews and artwork for other frontends (no effect on Jellyfin's stock UI)

versions.changelog: 1.3.0: find items by a genre or tag as it is shown. A new route, GET /KasuMeta/Items/ByTerm, returns the items whose localized genres or tags hold a name ("Terror" for a Spanish reader, where Jellyfin's own genre is "Horror"), ignoring case and accents, so a frontend can lead from a genre or tag it draws to every item that shows it. No effect on Jellyfin's stock UI: for frontends using the KasuMeta API. No database change.

1.2.0: choose the providers of each field (titles, overviews, taglines, genres, tags, posters, logos, backdrops) in order; the next ones fill what the first lacks. Fields with nothing in the reader's language fall back to the title's original language. Genres and tags, with a dictionary to translate English terms library-wide. Image uploads (up to 10 MB) as overrides. No effect on Jellyfin's stock UI: for frontends using the KasuMeta API. The library is fetched again once after updating.

1.1.0: TVDB as a metadata provider (API v4 key, plus PIN for user-supported keys). Choose TMDB only (the default, as before), TVDB only, or both with a priority weight each: per field, image and language the higher weight wins and the other fills the gaps. Changing the choice fetches the library again.

1.0.0: first release. Localized titles, overviews, taglines and artwork from TMDB, anime titles from AniList, search by localized name, admin overrides, and a status panel on the plugin page. Requires Jellyfin 12.x and a TMDB API key.
